[Package]
Name              = Acme Workstation IDE
Version           = 2.4.0
Manufacturer      = Acme Corporation
UpgradeCode       = {8F4E20A1-7C93-4D62-9B44-1029384756AB} ; Stable across upgrades
Architecture      = $(ARCH)
Scope             = machine
BuildBootstrapper = true

[Install]
DefaultSubdir     = AcmeWorkstation IDE
MainExecutable    = AcmeIde.exe

[UI]
WizardLayout      = standard
AccentPrimaryHex  = #2563EB
LicenseRtf        = License.rtf
InstallButtonText = &Install

[Payload.App]
Source            = ..publishwin-$(ARCH)

End-to-End Windows Packaging Workbench

Suite Spotlight: Visual IDE, AI-Native CLI & MSI Prism

InstallerStudio.exe — 7-View C++20 Visual IDE

Author standalone .rsip projects or multi-project .rsis suites (just like Visual Studio .slnx) with a real-time GDI Wizard Preview Canvas, PE version harvesting, and a lossless AST that preserves 100% of developer comments in git diff.

Explore .rsip & .rsis Format

instbuild.exe — Headless CI & AI Spec Compiler

Sub-millisecond --validate --diagnostics=json dry runs, automated --emit-vpat WCAG 2.2 AA conformance reports, and first-party --emit-ai-spec generation (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, SKILL.md) so coding agents write valid manifests on pass one.

View Live /llms.txt Spec

msiprism.exe — Native 64-Bit MSI & MST Inspector

The modern, blazing-fast 64-bit (x64 & ARM64) Dark Mode replacement for Microsoft's aging 1999 32-bit Orca.exe. Inspect SQL tables, verify ICE80 64-bit component flags, and diff .mst transforms or .msp patches effortlessly.

Review Security & SBOM
